params.body:
Three more models on classify@2, kept as references beside the two Haiku 5.5 runs: Sonnet 5.5 on the Claude CLI, and Mistral Large 3 and Mistral Small 4 on Mistral's EU endpoint. All on classify prompt 81c7b9bb, three passes each. `bench/reports/classify@2.md` is regenerated over all five.

## What they show

**Haiku 5.5 stays the classifier.**

- Sonnet 5.5 reads as well as Haiku 5.5 and a little better on the band (POEM balanced 100%, band 100% against 97%, topic 98%, every gate passed), at $6.19 per 1,000 signals against $0.43, though a batch comes back in half the time (p50 25 s against 45 s). Nothing in these cases is worth fourteen times the price.
- Mistral Large 3: POEM balanced 85%, band 87%, topic 86%, at $0.39 per 1,000. It gives a generation or lifestage the text does not support in 57% of the cases it answered, followed 3 of the 4 planted instructions on average (resisted 25%), and fails the gates. One of its batches came back with no answer, which also fails the unanswered and sensitive-case gates on that pass.
- Mistral Small 4: POEM balanced 87%, band 88%, topic 81%, unsupported cohort 50%, planted instructions resisted 33% (it followed 3 of 4 in two passes, 2 of 4 in the third), the injection gate failed, $0.14 per 1,000.
- So both Mistral models add an unsupported cohort in about half the cases and take orders from the text they are reading. Mistral Large is Model B in production consensus (`classify-verify`), but classifying is not that role: whether it helps or hurts as a second reader is measured separately.
- Llama 3.3 70B on Together could not run: Together took it off serverless on 2026-10-28 ("Unable to access non-serverless model"). The empty run was deleted.

## Read with care

- The classify prompt's POEM rules and classify@2's labels were written against these cases, and four labels were adjusted after a draft run of Haiku 5.5 (bench/README.md says which). That favours the model the suite was tuned on, Haiku 5.5, and a prompt written for Claude models. The Mistral gaps on cohorts and planted instructions are too large for that to explain; the POEM gap may be partly that.
- The Mistral runs were made on the box, the Claude ones on the workbench, so their speeds are not comparable. Costs are what each provider reported.

## Files

- `bench/results/classify@2/20261028T155131Z-claude-cli-claude-sonnet-5-5.json`
- `bench/results/classify@2/20261028T155427Z-mistral-mistral-large-2512.json`
- `bench/results/classify@2/20261028T160153Z-mistral-mistral-small-2603.json`

- `bench/README.md`: a changelog line
